Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 5, Verse 12

“The disciplined one, abandoning the fruit of action, attains lasting peace. The undisciplined one, attached to fruit through the working of desire, is bound.”

The same action, two outcomes, and the variable is not effort but appetite. Krishna keeps returning to this because Arjuna keeps hearing it as a call to do less.
